sources.name: Paid streets — Eixos Tarifados
sources.caveat: Paid-street geometry, not bay capacity, meter locations, live availability or occupancy.

sources.name: Limited-duration tariff zones — ZEDL
sources.caveat: Tariff polygons, not individual spaces. Rates are one-hour EUR references matching municipal guidance, not a linear duration calculator. Check current signage; not live availability or occupancy.

sources.name: Individual paid spaces — western area
sources.caveat: Western-area inventory only; active, inactive and unknown source statuses are preserved. Status is not current availability or occupancy; counts are not citywide capacity. Resident zones are not tariff classes.

sources.name: Municipal parking facilities
sources.caveat: Historical municipal facility inventory. Light-vehicle capacity is one source category, not total capacity or free spaces; other categories and missing values remain in the original attributes. Operators and hours may have changed. No live availability or occupancy.

sources.name: INE Census 2021 — statistical subsections (BGRI), Porto
sources.license: INE — open access, no conditions (cite INE, Censos 2021)
sources.caveat: Households in habitual residence and those with own parking, by census subsection, apportioned evenly across a 25 m lattice inside each subsection. Not a count of cars or of parking demand.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap — roads, car parks and points of interest (Overpass)
sources.caveat: Volunteer-mapped; completeness varies. Road parking-side tags are rare, so on-street supply is a modelled estimate, and car parks without a capacity tag are ignored.

sources.name: Traffic restrictions — parking conditions (CKAN)
sources.caveat: Only entries typed 'Estacionamento' with valid start and end dates; duration is capped at 366 days and placed at the geometry centroid. Historical, not current signage.

sources.name: ReportaPorto — parking-related occurrences
sources.license: No explicit licence; public web API (Lei 26/2016 art. 21.º(1)); aggregated counts only
sources.caveat: Citizen reports of irregular parking (sidewalk, double, cycle lane, abandoned vehicle); only code, position and request time are used, aggregated per cell. Reporting behaviour is uneven.

sources.name: PDM Porto 2021 diagnosis — public on-street parking total
sources.caveat: The citywide total of 64,680 public on-street spaces is distributed over the road network proportionally to eligible road length. Local supply is an estimate.
